sources.quote: For developers on the [paid tier](https://aistudio.google.com/app/plan_information), billing will start on Monday October 14th.

notes: Google's official 2024 launch announcement lists the same input and output prices and a $0.01 cached-token price, so the June 2025 cache_read addition reflects a models.dev omission/schema correction rather than a provider price change.
